parameters.name: Tuning Divisions Per Period
parameters.description: Equal divisions of the period (12 = standard 12-TET, 19/22/31/53 etc. for microtonal EDOs). Ignored while a custom scale table is loaded.

parameters.name: Tuning Period
parameters.description: Size of the repeating period. 1200 = octave, 1901.955 = tritave (Bohlen-Pierce).

parameters.name: Tuning Reference Note
parameters.description: MIDI note number that sounds at the reference frequency.

parameters.name: Tuning Reference Frequency
parameters.description: Frequency of the reference note.

parameters.name: Osc1 Waveform
parameters.description: Waveform of oscillator 1. Wavetable plays the bank chosen in Osc1 Wavetable at Osc1 WT Position.

parameters.name: Osc1 Pulse Width
parameters.description: Duty cycle of oscillator 1 when its waveform is Pulse (0.5 = square).

parameters.name: Osc1 Level
parameters.description: Mix level of oscillator 1.

parameters.name: Osc2 Waveform
parameters.description: Waveform of oscillator 2. Wavetable plays the bank chosen in Osc2 Wavetable at Osc2 WT Position.

parameters.name: Osc2 Pulse Width
parameters.description: Duty cycle of oscillator 2 when its waveform is Pulse (0.5 = square).

parameters.name: Osc2 Level
parameters.description: Mix level of oscillator 2.

parameters.name: Osc2 Transpose
parameters.description: Coarse pitch offset of oscillator 2 in cents (tuning independent; 1200 = one octave up).

parameters.name: Osc2 Detune
parameters.description: Fine detune of oscillator 2 against oscillator 1.

parameters.name: Sub Osc Level
parameters.description: Square wave one octave below oscillator 1.

parameters.name: Noise Level
parameters.description: White noise mixed into the filter input.

parameters.name: Osc2 Hard Sync
parameters.description: Restart oscillator 2 every cycle of oscillator 1 (classic sync lead; sweep Osc2 Transpose or Osc2 Env Pitch).

parameters.name: Osc2 Env Pitch
parameters.description: How far the filter envelope bends oscillator 2 pitch (sync sweeps, FM brightness changes).

parameters.name: FM Index
parameters.description: Phase modulation of oscillator 1 by oscillator 2 (0 = off; use Sine waves for bells/e-pianos).

parameters.name: Filter Mode
parameters.description: Filter response type.

parameters.name: Filter Cutoff
parameters.description: Base cutoff frequency of the resonant filter.

parameters.name: Filter Resonance
parameters.description: Filter resonance (approaches self-oscillation near 1).

parameters.name: Filter Slope
parameters.description: Filter slope: 2-pole or 4-pole.

parameters.name: Filter Drive
parameters.description: Soft saturation before the filter.

parameters.name: Filter Env Amount
parameters.description: How far the filter envelope moves the cutoff, in octaves.

parameters.name: Filter Key Tracking
parameters.description: Cutoff follows note frequency (1 = fully).

parameters.name: Filter Velocity Amount
parameters.description: How much note velocity scales the filter envelope.

parameters.name: Filter Env Attack
parameters.description: Filter envelope attack time.

parameters.name: Filter Env Decay
parameters.description: Filter envelope decay time.

parameters.name: Filter Env Sustain
parameters.description: Filter envelope sustain level.

parameters.name: Filter Env Release
parameters.description: Filter envelope release time.

parameters.name: Amp Attack
parameters.description: Amplitude envelope attack time.

parameters.name: Amp Decay
parameters.description: Amplitude envelope decay time.

parameters.name: Amp Sustain
parameters.description: Amplitude envelope sustain level.

parameters.name: Amp Release
parameters.description: Amplitude envelope release time.

parameters.name: Amp Velocity Amount
parameters.description: How much note velocity scales loudness (0 = ignore velocity).

parameters.name: LFO Waveform
parameters.description: Shape of the global LFO. Duck drops at the start of every cycle and recovers (sidechain-style pumping; use it with LFO Tremolo Depth and LFO Sync).

parameters.name: LFO Rate
parameters.description: Rate of the global LFO (used while LFO Sync is Off).

parameters.name: LFO Pitch Depth
parameters.description: Constant vibrato depth (independent of the mod wheel).

parameters.name: LFO Filter Depth
parameters.description: Constant filter cutoff modulation depth.

parameters.name: LFO Pulse Width Depth
parameters.description: Pulse width modulation (PWM) depth for Pulse waveforms.

parameters.name: LFO Tremolo Depth
parameters.description: Amplitude modulation (tremolo) depth.

parameters.name: Mod Wheel Vibrato Depth
parameters.description: Extra vibrato depth at full mod wheel.

parameters.name: Mod Wheel Filter LFO Depth
parameters.description: Extra filter cutoff wobble depth at full mod wheel.

parameters.name: Pitch Bend Range
parameters.description: Pitch bend range in cents (tuning independent; 200 = +/-2 semitones).

parameters.name: Max Voices
parameters.description: Maximum polyphony (1 = mono).

parameters.name: Glide Time
parameters.description: Portamento time from the previously played note (0 = off).

parameters.name: Unison Voices
parameters.description: Stacked detuned copies of both oscillators per note (supersaw-style thickness). CPU grows with Max Voices x Unison Voices.

parameters.name: Unison Detune
parameters.description: Total detune spread across the unison copies.

parameters.name: Unison Stereo Width
parameters.description: How far the unison copies are spread left/right.

parameters.name: Master Volume
parameters.description: Output volume of the synth.

parameters.name: Transpose
parameters.description: Shifts incoming notes by this many MIDI note numbers (= semitones in 12-EDO, scale steps in other tunings). Applied at note-on, so automating it never cuts off or hangs sounding notes.

parameters.name: Voice Mode
parameters.description: Poly: chords. Mono: one note at a time (last note wins, returns to a still-held note), envelopes restart on every note. Legato: like Mono, but overlapping notes only change pitch (no envelope restart).

parameters.name: Glide Mode
parameters.description: Always: every note glides from the previous one. Legato only: glide only when the new note overlaps a held note.

parameters.name: Unison Detune Curve
parameters.description: Spacing of the unison copies: 0 = even, 1 = bunched near the centre pitch with a few far-out copies (supersaw-like).

parameters.name: Unison Side Level
parameters.description: Level of the outer unison copies relative to the centre one(s) (1 = all equal).

parameters.name: LFO Sync
parameters.description: Lock the LFO to the host tempo: one cycle per note value, phase locked to the beat grid (so it restarts on the beat). Off = free running at LFO Rate.

parameters.name: Arp Mode
parameters.description: Arpeggiator on the held notes, in time with the host tempo. Chord repeats the whole chord on every step (stabs; shape the rhythm with the Arp Step switches).

parameters.name: Arp Rate
parameters.description: Length of one arpeggiator step (note value, tempo synced).

parameters.name: Arp Octave Range
parameters.description: How many octaves (tuning periods) the arpeggio climbs.

parameters.name: Arp Gate
parameters.description: Note length as a fraction of the step (1 = notes touch; with Voice Mode Legato they slur).

parameters.name: Arp Swing
parameters.description: Share of each pair of steps given to the first one (50 = straight, 66.7 = triplet shuffle).

parameters.name: Arp Pattern Length
parameters.description: Length of the step on/off pattern (Arp Step 1..16). The pattern restarts every this many steps, counted from beat 0 of the host.

parameters.name: Arp Step 1
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 1 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 2
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 2 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 3
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 3 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 4
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 4 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 5
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 5 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 6
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 6 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 7
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 7 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 8
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 8 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 9
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 9 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 10
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 10 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 11
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 11 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 12
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 12 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 13
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 13 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 14
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 14 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 15
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 15 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Arp Step 16
parameters.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 16 plays (Off = rest).

parameters.name: Noise Type
parameters.description: White: hiss. Chip Long / Short and Sample & Hold are clocked from the note pitch. Rotor: periodic blade thumps with air wash. Crowd Claps: eighteen independently timed short high-passed hand impacts. Shot: a very brief broadband crack with a short early reflection, restarted on note-on. Rain: continuous filtered rain wash with irregular short droplets of varying strength and resonance. The four sound FX sources ignore note pitch and are mixed at Noise Level before the main filter and amp envelope.

parameters.name: Noise Clock
parameters.description: Chip / S&H clock relative to the note (higher = brighter); at 0, Chip Short sounds at the note pitch. For Rotor / Crowd Claps / Rain this scales the blade / clap / droplet rate; for Shot it scales playback speed. These FX rates do not follow note pitch.

parameters.name: Noise Filter
parameters.description: Extra filter on the noise only (before the main filter), e.g. a high-passed hiss or a band of noise.

parameters.name: Noise Filter Cutoff
parameters.description: Cutoff / centre frequency of the noise filter.

parameters.name: Cutoff CC Number
parameters.description: MIDI CC that moves the filter cutoff (74 = brightness; 0 = none). CC value 64 = no change.

parameters.name: Cutoff CC Depth
parameters.description: How far the cutoff CC moves the cutoff: CC 0 = this many octaves down, CC 127 = up.

parameters.name: Tuning Source
parameters.description: EDO sliders: Tuning Divisions / Period. Scale file: a Scala (.scl) scale saved as REAPER/Data/AmiSynth/tuning.txt (re-read on playback start or any slider change). Shared: the scale (and reference note / frequency) published by an "AmiSynth Tuning" JSFX on any track for the slot in Tuning Slot; changes there apply at once. Falls back to the EDO sliders when the file / slot is empty.

parameters.name: Tuning Slot
parameters.description: Which AmiSynth Tuning instance to follow when Tuning Source is Shared (its Slot number), so one song can use several scales.

parameters.name: Chorus
parameters.description: Stereo chorus on the whole synth (first effect). Off = bypassed, no CPU.

parameters.name: Chorus Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet balance of the chorus (0 = dry, 0.5 = classic chorus, 1 = only the modulated copy: vibrato).

parameters.name: Chorus Rate
parameters.description: Speed of the chorus sweep (left and right a quarter cycle apart).

parameters.name: Chorus Depth
parameters.description: How far the delay sweeps (from 7 ms up to 7 ms + depth). More = more detune and wobble.

parameters.name: Delay
parameters.description: Stereo echo after the chorus. Off = bypassed, no CPU.

parameters.name: Delay Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet balance of the delay (0 = dry, 1 = only the echoes).

parameters.name: Delay Sync
parameters.description: Echo time as a note value at the host tempo (JSFX: REAPER tempo, web: BPM). Off = use Delay Time. Capped at 4 s.

parameters.name: Delay Time
parameters.description: Echo time in ms when Delay Sync is Off. Changes glide (tape-like) instead of clicking.

parameters.name: Delay Feedback
parameters.description: How much of each echo is fed back (more = more repeats).

parameters.name: Delay Ping-Pong
parameters.description: On: the echoes bounce left -> right -> left (input summed to mono). Off: each side echoes itself.

parameters.name: Delay High Cut
parameters.description: Low-pass in the feedback loop: every repeat gets darker (damping, like tape or analog delays).

parameters.name: Reverb
parameters.description: Algorithmic reverb (diffusers + 4-line feedback delay network) after the delay. Off = bypassed, no CPU.

parameters.name: Reverb Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet balance of the reverb (0 = dry, 1 = only the reverb).

parameters.name: Reverb Decay
parameters.description: Reverb time: how long the tail takes to fall by 60 dB.

parameters.name: Reverb Size
parameters.description: Size of the space (spacing of the reflections): 0 = small room, 1 = large hall.

parameters.name: Reverb Damping
parameters.description: How fast high frequencies die in the tail (0 = bright, 1 = dark).

parameters.name: Osc1 Wavetable
parameters.description: Wavetable bank of oscillator 1 (used while Osc1 Waveform is Wavetable). Basic Shapes: sine -> triangle -> saw -> square. PWM Sweep: pulse 50 % -> 5 %. Vocal Formants: vowels a-e-i-o-u. Harmonic Sweep: a band of harmonics rising 5 octaves. Digital: 8-bit XOR waveforms. Band-limited, generated in the synth (no samples).

parameters.name: Osc1 WT Position
parameters.description: Position in the oscillator 1 wavetable (0 = first frame, 1 = last; frames are crossfaded in between).

parameters.name: Osc2 Wavetable
parameters.description: Wavetable bank of oscillator 2 (used while Osc2 Waveform is Wavetable). Same banks as Osc1 Wavetable.

parameters.name: Osc2 WT Position
parameters.description: Position in the oscillator 2 wavetable (0 = first frame, 1 = last).

parameters.name: WT Position LFO
parameters.description: How far the global LFO moves the wavetable position of both oscillators (+/- this amount at the LFO peaks; the result is limited to 0..1).

parameters.name: WT Position Filter Env
parameters.description: How far the filter envelope moves the wavetable position of both oscillators (negative = moves it down).

parameters.name: WT Position Amp Env
parameters.description: How far the amp envelope moves the wavetable position of both oscillators (negative = moves it down).

parameters.name: LFO2 Waveform
parameters.description: Shape of the second global LFO. It only acts through the mod matrix (source LFO 2).

parameters.name: LFO2 Rate
parameters.description: Rate of LFO 2 (used while LFO2 Sync is Off).

parameters.name: LFO2 Sync
parameters.description: Lock LFO 2 to the host tempo (one cycle per note value, phase locked to the beat grid). Off = free running at LFO2 Rate.

parameters.name: Mod Env Attack
parameters.description: Attack time of the per-note modulation envelope (mod matrix source Mod Env).

parameters.name: Mod Env Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the modulation envelope.

parameters.name: Mod Env Sustain
parameters.description: Sustain level of the modulation envelope.

parameters.name: Mod Env Release
parameters.description: Release time of the modulation envelope.

parameters.name: Mod 1 Source
parameters.description: Mod matrix slot 1: what modulates. LFO 1 / LFO 2 / Random (a new value per note) swing -1..1; Mod Env, Velocity, Mod Wheel (CC1) and Pressure (channel pressure or polyphonic aftertouch) go 0..1; Key Track is the octaves above (+) / below (-) middle C. Off = slot unused.

parameters.name: Mod 1 Destination
parameters.description: Mod matrix slot 1: what is modulated (per note, except LFO 1 / LFO 2 Rate which are global and only follow LFO 1, LFO 2, Mod Wheel and channel pressure). Off = slot unused.

parameters.name: Mod 1 Amount
parameters.description: Mod matrix slot 1: how far the destination moves at source value 1, in the destination's unit: Pitch / Osc2 Pitch in cents, Filter Cutoff / LFO Rate in octaves, FM Index in rad, Amp in dB, Resonance / Pulse Width / Noise Level added to the knob value (0..1), Pan -1 (left) .. +1 (right). Negative values invert.

parameters.name: Mod 2 Source
parameters.description: Mod matrix slot 2: what modulates. LFO 1 / LFO 2 / Random (a new value per note) swing -1..1; Mod Env, Velocity, Mod Wheel (CC1) and Pressure (channel pressure or polyphonic aftertouch) go 0..1; Key Track is the octaves above (+) / below (-) middle C. Off = slot unused.

parameters.name: Mod 2 Destination
parameters.description: Mod matrix slot 2: what is modulated (per note, except LFO 1 / LFO 2 Rate which are global and only follow LFO 1, LFO 2, Mod Wheel and channel pressure). Off = slot unused.

parameters.name: Mod 2 Amount
parameters.description: Mod matrix slot 2: how far the destination moves at source value 1, in the destination's unit: Pitch / Osc2 Pitch in cents, Filter Cutoff / LFO Rate in octaves, FM Index in rad, Amp in dB, Resonance / Pulse Width / Noise Level added to the knob value (0..1), Pan -1 (left) .. +1 (right). Negative values invert.

parameters.description: Mod matrix slot 3: what modulates. LFO 1 / LFO 2 / Random (a new value per note) swing -1..1; Mod Env, Velocity, Mod Wheel (CC1) and Pressure (channel pressure or polyphonic aftertouch) go 0..1; Key Track is the octaves above (+) / below (-) middle C. Off = slot unused.

parameters.name: Mod 3 Destination
parameters.description: Mod matrix slot 3: what is modulated (per note, except LFO 1 / LFO 2 Rate which are global and only follow LFO 1, LFO 2, Mod Wheel and channel pressure). Off = slot unused.

parameters.name: Mod 3 Amount

presets.name: Init
presets.description: Default patch: detuned saw + square through a 24 dB low-pass.

presets.name: Acid Bass
presets.description: Single saw, resonant 24 dB filter with a snappy envelope and glide.

presets.name: Sub Bass
presets.description: Round sine + sub square, almost no filter movement.

presets.name: Pluck
presets.description: Short decaying saw/pulse pluck for arpeggios.

presets.name: FM Bell
presets.description: Sine carrier modulated by a sine at 3.5x: inharmonic bell. Velocity opens the FM via the envelope.

presets.name: FM E-Piano
presets.description: Sine 1:1 FM with a short bright attack (osc2 pitch envelope adds the tine "ding").

presets.name: Supersaw Lead
presets.description: 4-voice unison saws, wide stereo, slight glide.

presets.name: Sync Lead
presets.description: Osc2 hard-synced to osc1, its pitch swept by the filter envelope.

presets.name: Chiptune Square
presets.description: 12.5% pulse, no filter, instant envelopes: 8-bit console style.

presets.name: PWM Strings
presets.description: Two slowly pulse-width-modulated pulses, slow attack and release.

presets.name: Warm Pad
presets.description: Detuned triangle + saw, slow swelling filter.

presets.name: Brass
presets.description: Two saws, filter envelope with a slight attack "blat".

presets.name: Organ
presets.description: Square + octave-up square + sub, gate envelope, LFO tremolo.

presets.name: Wobble Bass
presets.description: Saw + sub through a resonant low-pass swept by a triangle LFO.

presets.name: Noise Sweep FX
presets.description: Band-passed noise riser; hold a note and let the filter envelope rise.

presets.name: Sample & Hold Blips
presets.description: Random filter steps from the S&H LFO over a resonant pulse.

presets.name: Hyper Saw
presets.description: 7 unison saws bunched around the centre pitch (supersaw), quieter outer copies, wide stereo.

presets.name: Eurobeat Arp
presets.description: Hold a chord: 1/16 up-arpeggio over 2 octaves in time with the host tempo. Short bright pluck.

presets.name: Off-beat Stabs
presets.description: Hold a chord: the Chord arpeggiator plays it on the 8th-note off-beats (rhythm gate), detuned saws.

presets.name: Pumping Pad
presets.description: Wide saw pad that ducks on every beat (synced Duck LFO on the volume), like a kick sidechain.

presets.name: Octave Legato Bass
presets.description: Mono legato saw bass: overlapping notes slide without restarting the envelope (glide only when legato).

presets.name: Chip Noise Drum
presets.description: 8-bit console style shift-register noise, short decay: pitch the note for hats (high) or snares (low).

presets.name: Chip Metal Noise
presets.description: Short-mode shift-register noise: a buzzy, metallic tone at the note pitch (8-bit bells, laser zaps).

presets.name: Rubber Mono Bass
presets.description: Rounded pulse/sub bass with a quick resonant envelope. Detached notes punch; overlaps slide.

presets.name: Reese Bass
presets.description: Detuned saw pair with a sub foundation and slow filter movement. Play single low notes.

presets.name: Hollow Pulse Lead
presets.description: Narrow pulse with triangle body and gentle PWM; mono legato for lyrical melodies.

presets.name: Soft Sine Lead
presets.description: Pure sine with a faint octave overtone, slow legato slides and mod-wheel vibrato.

presets.name: Poly Chord Stab
presets.description: Short saw/pulse chord hits without an arpeggiator. Use off-beat MIDI chords for house or pop.

presets.name: Slow Chord Wash
presets.description: Soft triangle/pulse layers, rising filter and subtle stereo drift. Release before the next large chord.

presets.name: Glass Pluck
presets.description: Octave-ratio sine FM with a short glassy transient; play individual notes or small chords.

presets.name: Dusty Keys
presets.description: Dark triangle/pulse keys with a little filtered noise and slow pitch wobble. No samples or bit crusher.

presets.name: Triplet Cascade
presets.description: Hold a chord for a descending two-octave triplet arpeggio; short pulse/triangle plucks.

presets.name: Rhythmic Steps
presets.description: Hold a chord for a swung, five-step up/down pattern with a rest on step 3. Follows host tempo.

presets.name: Ambient Hall Pad
presets.description: Slow detuned saw/triangle pad through chorus and a long, dark hall reverb.

presets.name: Chorus Strings
presets.description: One PWM pulse per note thickened by a stereo chorus (80s string machine), with a small room.

presets.name: Dotted Delay Lead
presets.description: Mono saw lead with a dotted-eighth ping-pong delay synced to the tempo, plus a little reverb.

presets.name: Ping-Pong Pluck
presets.description: Short square pluck bouncing left and right on 1/8 echoes (tempo synced); repeats get darker.

presets.name: Dub Chord
presets.description: Short filtered chord stab into a dark, long dotted-quarter delay and a spring-like small reverb.

presets.name: Vowel Choir Pad
presets.description: Two vocal-formant wavetables drifting through the vowels with a slow LFO; wide unison. Hold chords.

presets.name: Morphing Wave Lead
presets.description: Basic Shapes wavetable: each note starts square-ish and settles toward a soft triangle with the filter envelope. Legato glide.

presets.name: Harmonic Scan Pluck
presets.description: Harmonic Sweep wavetable driven by the amp envelope: the band of harmonics falls as the note decays. Notes or small chords.

presets.name: Digital Growl Bass
presets.description: Digital (8-bit XOR) wavetable scanned by an 1/8-note synced LFO over a sub; mono. Play single low notes.

presets.name: PWM Sweep Strings
presets.description: PWM Sweep wavetable on both oscillators at two pulse widths, swept together by a slow LFO: an ensemble-like string pad.

presets.name: Pressure Pad
presets.description: Slow saw pad that opens and shimmers as you press into the keys (aftertouch -> cutoff and vibrato speed); LFO 2 drifts it across the stereo field, each note a little detuned at random.

presets.name: Sync Sweep Lead
presets.description: Hard-sync lead whose sync sweep comes from the mod envelope; harder notes open the filter, aftertouch pushes the sync pitch higher (screams).

presets.name: Tempo Wobble Bass
presets.description: LFO 2 locked to 1/8 notes sweeps the cutoff (dubstep-style wobble, follows the host tempo); aftertouch adds resonance, the mod wheel adds a second, faster filter wobble from LFO 1.

presets.name: Scatter Pluck
presets.description: Every note gets its own random pan position and brightness, and a quick pitch blip from the mod envelope at the attack: lively plucked chords.

presets.name: DX E-Piano
presets.description: Glassy FM electric piano (GM EP 2): 1:1 sine FM whose index falls from bright to mellow with the mod envelope.

presets.name: String Ensemble
presets.description: Section strings: five detuned saws, slow bow-like attack, warm low-pass, chorus and a hall.

presets.name: Tremolo Strings
presets.description: The string ensemble bowed in fast tremolo (about 8 strokes per second) for tension under a cue.

presets.name: Choir Aahs
presets.description: Vocal Formants wavetable held on the "a" vowel, unison voices, gentle vibrato and a church-like reverb.

presets.name: Voice Oohs
presets.description: The choir on a closed "u" vowel: darker and softer, for backing pads.

presets.name: Orchestra Hit
presets.description: Short tutti stab: wide saws plus a fifth above, a noise burst and a big hall. Play single notes or octaves.

presets.name: Brass Section
presets.description: The Brass patch as a section: three-voice unison, chorus and a room. Play chords.

presets.name: Calliope Lead
presets.description: Steam-whistle lead: triangle plus breathy noise with a wide, quick vibrato.

presets.name: Chiff Lead
presets.description: Soft flute-like lead with a breathy "chiff" of noise at the start of every note.

presets.name: Fifths Lead
presets.description: Two saws a perfect fifth apart: every note is a power chord. Mono legato.

presets.name: Bass + Lead
presets.description: Saw lead doubled an octave down with a sub: one mono line covers both bass and melody.

presets.name: New Age Pad
presets.description: A bell-like FM ping on top of a soft swelling pad: the attack sparkles, the tail glows.

presets.name: Bowed Pad
presets.description: Glass-harmonica-like pad: slow swelling triangles with bow noise and a filter that opens as the note grows.

presets.name: Metallic Pad
presets.description: Inharmonic sine FM (3.5x) with a slow attack and chorus: a cold, shimmering metal pad.

presets.name: Rain
presets.description: Rainfall: a steady rain wash with irregular short surface droplets of different strengths and resonances. Hold a note; Noise Clock changes droplet density.

presets.name: Soundtrack
presets.description: Cinematic swell: dark saws slowly opening over several seconds into a long hall.

presets.name: Crystal
presets.description: High inharmonic FM pings bouncing on a ping-pong delay into reverb: icy sparkles.

presets.name: Brightness
presets.description: Very bright, wide hard-sync pad with a shimmer of reverb.

presets.name: Goblin
presets.description: Muttering creature: the vowel wavetable jumps randomly with a slow sample & hold, through a resonant filter.

presets.name: Echo Drops
presets.description: Short sine-FM drops repeating on a long dotted ping-pong delay (tempo synced).

presets.name: Sci-Fi
presets.description: FM drone whose modulator pitch is swept by two slow LFOs: bubbling spaceship computer.

presets.name: Synth Drum
presets.description: Electronic tom (Simmons-style): a sine that drops two octaves in a few tens of ms, with a click of noise. Tune with the key.

presets.name: Reverse Cymbal
presets.description: High-passed noise swelling up over 1.5 s and cut off sharply, like a cymbal played backwards. Hold the note.

presets.name: Breath Noise
presets.description: Breathing air: band-passed noise that swells in and out slowly.

presets.name: Seashore
presets.description: Waves on a beach: low-passed noise whose cutoff and level surge with a slow LFO. Hold a note.

presets.name: Bird Tweet
presets.description: Chirping bird: a high sine trilled by a fast LFO with an upward pitch flick on each note. Play high.

presets.name: Telephone Ring
presets.description: Old bell telephone: two pulse tones a third apart, chopped by a fast square tremolo.

presets.name: Helicopter
presets.description: Rotor blades: repeated low pressure thumps with a decaying air wash over a steady engine rumble. Hold a note; Noise Clock changes rotor speed, not note pitch.

presets.name: Applause
presets.description: Crowd applause: eighteen independently timed, short hand impacts with reduced low body, overlapping into a crowd and room tail. Hold a note; Noise Clock changes crowd activity.

presets.name: Gunshot
presets.description: Short gunshot: a sharp broadband crack and short early reflection without a pitched bass thump. Each note-on fires once, even if held; Noise Clock changes playback speed.

macros.name: Punch
macros.description: Higher values shorten attack and decay.

macros.name: Width
macros.description: Unison count, detune and stereo width.

macros.name: Pump
macros.description: Quarter-note Duck LFO; replaces the current LFO waveform and sync.

parameters.name: Tuning Divisions Per Period
parameters.description: Equal divisions of the period (12 = standard 12-TET, 19/22/31/53 etc. for microtonal EDOs). Ignored while a custom scale table is loaded.

parameters.name: Tuning Period
parameters.description: Size of the repeating period. 1200 = octave, 1901.955 = tritave (Bohlen-Pierce).

parameters.name: Tuning Reference Note
parameters.description: MIDI note number that sounds at the reference frequency.

parameters.name: Tuning Reference Frequency
parameters.description: Frequency of the reference note.

parameters.name: Physical Model
parameters.description: String: plucked delay-line loop. Modal: tuned resonators struck by a mallet. Bowed: delay lines + bow friction. Wind: bore + reed/jet. Mesh: 2D wave equation on a grid. Stiff string: string with dispersion (inharmonic partials). Brass: bore + buzzing lips. Organ: nine drawbar sine partials (tonewheel organ) with percussion and key click.

parameters.name: String Excitation
parameters.description: What initially fills the delay line: a burst of noise (plucked) or a smooth pulse (hammered).

parameters.name: String Decay
parameters.description: Time for the fundamental to fall by 60 dB while the key is held (loop gain per round trip).

parameters.name: String Damping
parameters.description: Low-pass in the loop: higher = high harmonics die out faster (nylon/felt-like).

parameters.name: String Pick Position
parameters.description: Where the string is plucked (0.5 = middle, removes even harmonics; near 0 = bright/thin).

parameters.name: String Pick Brightness
parameters.description: Spectrum of the excitation (soft finger vs hard pick).

parameters.name: Modal Material
parameters.description: Set of mode frequency ratios / gains (measured or textbook values for each object).

parameters.name: Modal Decay
parameters.description: Decay time (-60 dB) of the lowest mode.

parameters.name: Modal High Mode Damping
parameters.description: How much faster higher modes decay than the fundamental.

parameters.name: Modal Mallet Hardness
parameters.description: Short hard mallet (1) excites high modes; long soft mallet (0) mostly the low ones.

parameters.name: Modal Strike Position
parameters.description: Where the object is struck; modes with a node there are not excited (approximation: sin(pi*k*pos)).

parameters.name: Modal Ratio Stretch
parameters.description: Bends the mode ratios toward (negative) or away from (positive) harmonic, to hear what inharmonicity does.

parameters.name: Bow Pressure
parameters.description: Force of the bow on the string: low = airy/flautando, high = gritty (steeper friction curve).

parameters.name: Bow Speed
parameters.description: Bow velocity (loudness and brightness of the Helmholtz motion).

parameters.name: Bow Position
parameters.description: Distance of the bow from the bridge (small = sul ponticello, larger = sul tasto).

parameters.name: Bow Attack
parameters.description: Time for the bow to reach full speed.

parameters.name: Bowed String Brightness
parameters.description: Losses of high frequencies at the bridge (string material / damping).

parameters.name: Wind Type
parameters.description: Clarinet: a reed valve at the closed end of a cylindrical bore (odd harmonics). Flute: an air jet across an open bore. Saxophone / Oboe: a reed on a conical bore (all harmonics); the double reed sits further down a narrower cone, for a thinner, nasal tone. Free reed: a metal tongue swinging through a slot at its own pitch (accordion, harmonica, harmonium); breath pressure sets how far it swings (louder, fuller), embouchure the reed offset (tone).

parameters.name: Breath Pressure
parameters.description: Blowing pressure; too low does not start the tone, too high overblows.

parameters.name: Breath Noise
parameters.description: Turbulence noise mixed into the breath.

parameters.name: Breath Attack
parameters.description: Time for the breath pressure to build up.

parameters.name: Embouchure
parameters.description: Reed stiffness (clarinet) or the air jet offset against the edge (flute: more even harmonics).

parameters.name: Mesh Shape
parameters.description: Shape of the vibrating 2D surface (fixed edges).

parameters.name: Mesh Resolution
parameters.description: Grid points per side (more = more modes and a smoother sound, but more CPU). Max 3 voices in this model.

parameters.name: Mesh Decay
parameters.description: Overall decay time of the surface.

parameters.name: Mesh High Damping
parameters.description: Extra damping of short wavelengths (high modes die faster, like a skin).

parameters.name: Mesh Strike X
parameters.description: Horizontal strike position (0.5 = centre).

parameters.name: Mesh Strike Y
parameters.description: Vertical strike position (0.5 = centre). Hitting the centre excites mostly the symmetric modes.

parameters.name: Mesh Mallet Hardness
parameters.description: Small hard mallet (1) vs broad soft mallet (0).

parameters.name: Piano Inharmonicity
parameters.description: String stiffness: higher partials are pushed sharp (dispersion all-passes in the loop, set per note from a piano-like B curve). 0.35 = typical piano, 1 = about 8x.

parameters.name: Piano Hammer Hardness
parameters.description: Felt stiffness of the hammer. The felt hardens as it is compressed, so louder notes are always brighter; this sets the overall brightness.

parameters.name: Piano Strike Position
parameters.description: Where the hammer hits (about 1/8 on real pianos).

parameters.name: Piano Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the fundamental while the key is held.

parameters.name: Piano Damping
parameters.description: Extra loss of high partials per round trip.

parameters.name: Piano Soundboard
parameters.description: How much of the sound comes through the soundboard (16 resonances fed by the bridge) instead of straight from the strings.

parameters.name: Piano Unison Detune
parameters.description: Two strings per note slightly detuned: slow beating and a two-stage decay.

parameters.name: Vibrato Depth
parameters.description: Pitch vibrato for the delay-line models (string, bowed, wind, stiff string).

parameters.name: Vibrato Rate
parameters.description: Vibrato speed.

parameters.name: Release Damping
parameters.description: Decay time after the key is released (like a damper touching the string/bar).

parameters.name: Velocity Amount
parameters.description: How much velocity changes loudness and brightness.

parameters.name: Stereo Width
parameters.description: Spreads low notes left and high notes right.

parameters.name: Pitch Bend Range
parameters.description: Pitch bend range in cents.

parameters.name: Room
parameters.description: Amount of a small room (4-line feedback delay network). Acoustic instruments sound dry and synthetic without one.

parameters.name: Room Decay
parameters.description: Reverberation time (T60) of the room.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: Output volume of the physical model instrument.

parameters.name: Brass Blowing Pressure
parameters.description: Mouth pressure: louder and brighter (brass get brassier the harder they are blown). Velocity adds to it.

parameters.name: Brass Lip Buzz
parameters.description: How easily the lips open: more = a buzzier, edgier tone.

parameters.name: Brass Attack
parameters.description: How fast the pressure builds up (short = a tongued attack).

parameters.name: Brass Bell Brightness
parameters.description: Low-pass of the sound leaving the bell; low values sound like a mute or a horn played into the hand.

parameters.name: Tuning Source
parameters.description: EDO sliders: Tuning Divisions / Period. Scale file: a Scala (.scl) scale saved as REAPER/Data/AmiSynth/tuning.txt (re-read on playback start or any slider change). Shared: the scale (and reference note / frequency) published by an "AmiSynth Tuning" JSFX on any track for the slot in Tuning Slot; changes there apply at once. Falls back to the EDO sliders when the file / slot is empty.

parameters.name: Amp
parameters.description: Guitar amp after the instrument (before the room): pre EQ, drive and a speaker cabinet filter. Clean adds only colour; Crunch to Distortion clip harder (Distortion has two gain stages). Mostly for the String model (electric guitar).

parameters.name: Amp Gain
parameters.description: Drive into the amp (range depends on the amp type).

parameters.name: Amp Tone
parameters.description: Brightness of the speaker cabinet (its high-frequency roll-off).

parameters.name: Amp Level
parameters.description: Output level of the amp.

parameters.name: Tuning Slot
parameters.description: Which AmiSynth Tuning instance to follow when Tuning Source is Shared (its Slot number), so one song can use several scales.

parameters.name: Sustain Pedal
parameters.description: MIDI CC64 delays note-off damping until pedal release. Auto supports plucked strings, piano and modal materials except Drum Membrane; bowed, wind, brass and mesh ignore it. On sustains all models. Natural decay still continues.

parameters.name: Pressure to Breath / Bow
parameters.description: How much aftertouch (channel pressure or polyphonic aftertouch, 0..1) adds to Breath Pressure (wind), Brass Blowing Pressure (brass) and Bow Pressure (bowed) while a note sounds. 0 = off.

parameters.name: Pressure to Vibrato
parameters.description: Extra vibrato depth at full aftertouch, per note (delay-line models: string, bowed, wind, stiff string, brass). 0 = off.

parameters.name: Pressure to Brightness
parameters.description: How much aftertouch adds to Bowed String Brightness (bowed) and Brass Bell Brightness (brass). 0 = off.

parameters.name: Drawbar 16'
parameters.description: Sub-octave. 0 = pushed in, each step +3 dB, 8 = full (as on a tonewheel organ).

parameters.name: Drawbar 5 1/3'
parameters.description: Fifth above the fundamental (3rd harmonic of the sub-octave). 0 = pushed in, each step +3 dB, 8 = full (as on a tonewheel organ).

parameters.name: Drawbar 8'
parameters.description: Fundamental. 0 = pushed in, each step +3 dB, 8 = full (as on a tonewheel organ).

parameters.name: Drawbar 4'
parameters.description: Octave. 0 = pushed in, each step +3 dB, 8 = full (as on a tonewheel organ).

parameters.name: Drawbar 2 2/3'
parameters.description: Twelfth (octave + fifth). 0 = pushed in, each step +3 dB, 8 = full (as on a tonewheel organ).

parameters.name: Drawbar 2'
parameters.description: Two octaves. 0 = pushed in, each step +3 dB, 8 = full (as on a tonewheel organ).

parameters.name: Drawbar 1 3/5'
parameters.description: Seventeenth (two octaves + major third). 0 = pushed in, each step +3 dB, 8 = full (as on a tonewheel organ).

parameters.name: Drawbar 1 1/3'
parameters.description: Nineteenth (two octaves + fifth). 0 = pushed in, each step +3 dB, 8 = full (as on a tonewheel organ).

parameters.name: Drawbar 1'
parameters.description: Three octaves. 0 = pushed in, each step +3 dB, 8 = full (as on a tonewheel organ).

parameters.name: Percussion
parameters.description: A decaying extra partial at the octave or the twelfth on each attack. Single trigger: only a note played with no other key held starts it, so legato lines do not re-strike.

parameters.name: Percussion Decay
parameters.description: Time for the percussion to fall by 60 dB (fast ~ 200 ms, slow ~ 1000 ms).

parameters.name: Percussion Level
parameters.description: Loudness of the percussion partial.

parameters.name: Key Click
parameters.description: Short noise burst of the key contacts closing.

parameters.name: Rotary Speaker
parameters.description: Rotating speaker after the amp: a horn (highs, Doppler + loudness swirl) and a drum (lows) spin at their own speeds and speed up / slow down gradually. The mod wheel above half switches Slow to Fast. Works on every model.

parameters.name: Rotary Mix
parameters.description: Share of the rotary speaker in the output (1 = the speaker only).

parameters.name: Free Reed Musette
parameters.description: Free reed only: two more reeds this many cents above and below the note beat against it (accordion musette / tremolo). 0 = a single reed.

parameters.name: String Sawari
parameters.description: Sitar / tanpura bridge (jawari): the string grazes a flat curved bridge on every swing, which keeps folding energy into the high partials - the sustained buzz. Higher = the string lies on the bridge for more of each cycle. 0 = an ordinary bridge.

presets.name: Nylon Guitar
presets.description: Soft plucked string: strong loop damping, warm pick, plucked away from the bridge.

presets.name: Steel String
presets.description: Bright, long-sustaining steel string picked near the bridge.

presets.name: Harp
presets.description: Plucked near the middle (fewer even harmonics), rings on after release.

presets.name: Koto-ish
presets.description: Plucked very close to the bridge with a hard pick: thin and twangy.

presets.name: Sitar
presets.description: Jawari bridge (String Sawari): the string buzzes against the curved bridge, so the bright, nasal partials keep ringing.

presets.name: Shamisen
presets.description: Hard plectrum near the bridge with a light sawari buzz; short, percussive decay.

presets.name: Hammered Dulcimer
presets.description: Hammer pulse instead of a noise burst, long ring.

presets.name: Clean Electric
presets.description: Bright steel string through a clean amp: picked near the bridge, long sustain, a little room.

presets.name: Jazz Guitar
presets.description: Warm, round archtop sound: neck-pickup-like (picked further from the bridge), tone rolled off.

presets.name: Crunch Rhythm
presets.description: Amp on the edge of breakup: chords stay clear, harder picking growls.

presets.name: Overdrive Lead
presets.description: Singing lead: overdriven, long sustain, a little vibrato and room. Use pitch bend for bends.

presets.name: Distortion Power Chord
presets.description: High-gain two-stage distortion for rock / eurobeat riffs: play root + fifth (+ octave).

presets.name: Palm Mute Chug
presets.description: Distorted strings damped right after the pick (palm mute): short, punchy 8th-note chugs.

presets.name: Marimba
presets.description: Tuned bar (modes ~1 : 3.9 : 9.2), soft-ish mallet, high modes die quickly.

presets.name: Vibraphone
presets.description: Metal bar tuned 1 : 4 : 10 with a long sustain.

presets.name: Glockenspiel
presets.description: Untuned free bar (1 : 2.76 : 5.40): the classic inharmonic shimmer.

presets.name: Wine Glass
presets.description: Glass modes, very little high damping, gently struck.

presets.name: Church Bell
presets.description: Hum / prime / tierce / quint / nominal partials, very long decay.

presets.name: Kalimba
presets.description: Plucked tine: strong fundamental, one high partial (~5.9x).

presets.name: Gamelan Gong
presets.description: Large bossed gong: deep fundamental with a slowly beating twin mode (ombak), very long decay. Play low notes.

presets.name: Bonang
presets.description: Small kettle gong of the gamelan: bright, ringing, a little beating. Good with 5-EDO (slendro-like) tuning.

presets.name: Hand Drum
presets.description: Circular membrane modes (1 : 1.59 : 2.14 ...), short decay.

presets.name: Violin
presets.description: Waveguide string driven by a stick-slip bow, bowed near the bridge, with a little vibrato.

presets.name: Cello
presets.description: Slower bow, darker bridge, slower vibrato. Play it low.

presets.name: Sul Ponticello
presets.description: Bowed very close to the bridge with light pressure: glassy, upper partials take over.

presets.name: Clarinet
presets.description: Reed + cylindrical bore: closed at one end, so mostly odd harmonics.

presets.name: Breathy Flute
presets.description: Air jet across the embouchure hole, lots of breath noise.

presets.name: Pan Pipe
presets.description: Jet driven pipe with a soft, round attack and little vibrato.

presets.name: Tom
presets.description: 2D membrane mesh struck off-centre: inharmonic drum modes appear by themselves.

presets.name: Steel Plate
presets.description: Square plate, hard strike near the corner, long ring with little high damping.

presets.name: Grand Piano
presets.description: Two detuned stiff strings per note: stretched partials, beating, long decay.

presets.name: Honky-tonk
presets.description: Badly tuned unison and a hard hammer.

presets.name: Bell-ish Strings
presets.description: Inharmonicity at maximum: the stretched partials start to sound like a bell.

presets.name: Trumpet
presets.description: Buzzing lips on a bore two periods long, bright bell, a touch of vibrato. Brighter the harder you play.

presets.name: Trombone
presets.description: Softer lips and a darker bell; play it low.

presets.name: French Horn
presets.description: Gentle lips and a hand in the bell (very dark), slow attack, bigger room.

presets.name: Flugelhorn
presets.description: Mellow: little lip buzz, soft attack, round bell.

presets.name: Muted Nylon
presets.description: Short, softly damped plucks with little room; use for intimate rhythmic picking.

presets.name: Felt Piano
presets.description: Soft hammer, damped upper partials and gentle string beating; a quiet piano texture with a small room.

presets.name: Glass Atmosphere
presets.description: Soft glass strikes with long ringing tails and a wide room. Leave space between chords.

presets.name: Pure Flute
presets.description: Low breath noise, gentle attack and restrained vibrato for clear sustained melodies.

presets.name: Expressive Violin
presets.description: The Violin with aftertouch: pressing harder digs the bow in, brightens the bridge and widens the vibrato (needs a keyboard with aftertouch, or the Pressure strip).

presets.name: Breath Trumpet
presets.description: Trumpet blown by aftertouch: soft keys start mellow, pressing in blows harder (brassier, brighter bell) and adds vibrato.

presets.name: Breath Clarinet
presets.description: Clarinet with aftertouch as breath: press in for more reed pressure and a little vibrato.

presets.name: Acoustic Bass
presets.description: Upright bass: soft finger pluck in the middle of a heavily damped string, short woody body. Play in octaves 1-2.

presets.name: Finger Bass
presets.description: Electric bass played with the fingers: round attack, long sustain through a clean amp.

presets.name: Pick Bass
presets.description: Electric bass played with a pick near the bridge: clicky, bright attack for rock lines.

presets.name: Fretless Bass
presets.description: Mellow singing bass with slow vibrato; the pitch bend spans an octave for slides.

presets.name: Slap Bass
presets.description: Thumb slap: a hard hammer strike right at the bridge end, bright and percussive, with a short decay.

presets.name: Harpsichord
presets.description: Quill plucking close to the end of a thin, lightly damped string; the damper stops it quickly on release.

presets.name: Clavinet
presets.description: Tangent strike at the very end of the string through a bright clean amp: funky, short and nasal.

presets.name: Bright Piano
presets.description: Grand piano with hard hammers and less damping of the upper partials; cuts through a mix.

presets.name: Electric Grand
presets.description: Short-stringed electric grand (CP-style): hard hammers, almost no soundboard, wider chorus-like unison, clean amp.

presets.name: Viola
presets.description: Between the violin and the cello: medium pressure, slightly darker and slower vibrato.

presets.name: Contrabass
presets.description: Arco double bass: heavy bow, slow attack and a dark tone. Play in octaves 1-2.

presets.name: Fiddle
presets.description: Folk fiddle: bright, quick bow attack and little room for dance tunes.

presets.name: Pizzicato Strings
presets.description: Plucked orchestral strings: finger pluck mid-string, short damped decay and a concert room.

presets.name: Piccolo
presets.description: Small bright flute: pure jet, quick attack and a fast light vibrato. Play an octave above the flute.

presets.name: Recorder
presets.description: Fixed windway, so a steady, almost noise-free tone with a fast attack and no vibrato.

presets.name: Shakuhachi
presets.description: Very breathy bamboo flute with a soft, slow-blooming attack and wide, slow vibrato.

presets.name: Whistle
presets.description: Tin whistle: thin, bright and pure with a lively vibrato.

presets.name: Ocarina
presets.description: Round, hollow vessel flute: centred jet (few even harmonics), very little noise, gentle vibrato.

presets.name: Blown Bottle
presets.description: Air blown across a bottle neck: lots of turbulence, low pressure and a slow swell.

presets.name: Tuba
presets.description: Big dark brass: low lip buzz, slow attack, closed bell. Play in octaves 1-2.

presets.name: Xylophone
presets.description: Hard mallets on short rosewood bars: bright, dry and quickly decaying.

presets.name: Tubular Bells
presets.description: Chimes: tubular-bell modes (the strike note an octave below the 4th mode) hit with a hard hammer, a long ring and a big room. Play in octaves 4-5.

presets.name: Celesta
presets.description: Felt hammers on small steel bars: a soft, sweet glockenspiel with a shorter tail.

presets.name: Music Box
presets.description: Plucked steel comb: kalimba-like tines, very hard and bright, lightly ringing. Play high.

presets.name: Tinkle Bell
presets.description: Small bright bell: church-bell modes, very hard strike and a short shimmer.

presets.name: Agogo
presets.description: Clanky metal cowbell: kettle-gong modes, hard stick, short decay.

presets.name: Steel Drums
presets.description: Trinidad steel pan: note areas tuned to fundamental, octave and twelfth, rubber-tipped sticks and a warm room.

presets.name: Woodblock
presets.description: Hollow wooden block: bar modes, very hard stick, almost no ring.

presets.name: Taiko
presets.description: Huge Japanese drum: large circular membrane, soft heavy beater and a hall. Play low.

presets.name: Timpani
presets.description: Kettle drum: membrane struck near the rim with a felt mallet, long pitched boom. Play in octaves 2-3.

presets.name: Soprano Sax
presets.description: Straight soprano: stiff reed, bright and focused, quick vibrato. Play in octaves 4-5.

presets.name: Alto Sax
presets.description: Alto saxophone: medium reed, some breath and a singing vibrato. Play in octaves 3-5.

presets.name: Tenor Sax
presets.description: Tenor saxophone: soft reed blown hard, breathy and husky. Play in octaves 2-4.

presets.name: Baritone Sax
presets.description: Bari sax: the softest reed and full pressure for a gruff low honk. Play in octaves 1-3.

presets.name: Oboe
presets.description: Oboe: double reed on a narrow cone, thin and nasal with a gentle vibrato. Play in octaves 4-5.

presets.name: English Horn
presets.description: Cor anglais: a darker, softer oboe a fifth lower, slower attack. Play in octaves 3-4.

presets.name: Bassoon
presets.description: Bassoon: double reed, reedy and woody, almost no vibrato. Play in octaves 2-3.

presets.name: Shanai
presets.description: Shehnai: piercing double reed, hard-blown with a wide, fast vibrato. Play in octaves 4-5.

presets.name: Drawbar Organ
presets.description: Tonewheel organ, 888000000 registration (16' 5 1/3' 8'): round and full, rotary speaker on slow. Mod wheel up = fast rotor.

presets.name: Percussive Organ
presets.description: Jazz organ: 888000000 with fast third-harmonic percussion (single trigger: play detached to re-strike) and key click, slow rotor.

presets.name: Rock Organ
presets.description: Overdriven tonewheel organ (888600000) through a crunch amp and a fast rotary speaker, loud key click.

presets.name: Gospel Organ
presets.description: All drawbars out (888888888): bright and huge, fast rotor. Mod wheel down to keep it fast; try slow rotor for chords.

presets.name: Ballad Organ
presets.description: Soft 8' + 4' (008800000) on a slow rotor, little click: pads behind a band.

presets.name: Church Organ
presets.description: Organ chorus 16' 8' 4' 2 2/3' 2' 1' without rotary or click in a big room, a slower release (stands in for a pipe organ).

presets.name: Accordion
presets.description: Musette accordion: three reeds per note, one in tune and two about 12 cents above and below, so every note shimmers. Steady bellows.

presets.name: Bandoneon
presets.description: Tango bandoneon: a single dry reed, darker and pushed harder, with a slower bellows attack.

presets.name: Harmonica
presets.description: Blues harp: one bright reed, breathy, a hand-tremolo vibrato; aftertouch blows harder. Bend range two semitones.

presets.name: Reed Organ
presets.description: Harmonium / pump organ: soft, round free reeds with a slow attack and a gentle beat between two ranks.

parameters.name: Kick Pitch
parameters.description: Final (resting) frequency of the kick sine.

parameters.name: Kick Decay
parameters.description: Amplitude decay time of the kick (to -60 dB).

parameters.name: Kick Tone
parameters.description: Click transient and saturation amount.

parameters.name: Kick Level
parameters.description: Output level of the kick.

parameters.name: Kick Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the kick (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Kick Pitch Sweep Depth
parameters.description: How many octaves above the resting pitch the kick starts.

parameters.name: Kick Pitch Sweep Time
parameters.description: Time constant of the downward pitch sweep.

parameters.name: Snare Pitch
parameters.description: Frequency of the tonal (drum shell) component.

parameters.name: Snare Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the noise (snares) component.

parameters.name: Snare Tone
parameters.description: Brightness of the band-passed noise (low = dark, high = bright).

parameters.name: Snare Level
parameters.description: Output level of the snare.

parameters.name: Snare Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the snare (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Snare Snappy
parameters.description: Balance between tonal body (0) and noise (1).

parameters.name: Clap Pitch
parameters.description: Center frequency of the band-pass filter on the noise.

parameters.name: Clap Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the reverberant tail after the bursts.

parameters.name: Clap Tone
parameters.description: Filter sharpness (low = wide/noisy, high = narrow/ringing).

parameters.name: Clap Level
parameters.description: Output level of the clap.

parameters.name: Clap Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the clap (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Clap Burst Spread
parameters.description: Gap between the individual hand-clap bursts.

parameters.name: Closed Hi-Hat Pitch
parameters.description: Base frequency of the metallic square-wave cluster.

parameters.name: Closed Hi-Hat Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the closed hi-hat.

parameters.name: Closed Hi-Hat Tone
parameters.description: High-pass cutoff (brightness).

parameters.name: Closed Hi-Hat Level
parameters.description: Output level of the closed hi-hat.

parameters.name: Closed Hi-Hat Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the closed hi-hat (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Closed Hi-Hat Metal Mix
parameters.description: Balance between noise (0) and detuned square cluster (1).

parameters.name: Open Hi-Hat Pitch
parameters.description: Base frequency of the metallic square-wave cluster.

parameters.name: Open Hi-Hat Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the open hi-hat (closed hi-hat chokes it).

parameters.name: Open Hi-Hat Tone
parameters.description: High-pass cutoff (brightness).

parameters.name: Open Hi-Hat Level
parameters.description: Output level of the open hi-hat.

parameters.name: Open Hi-Hat Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the open hi-hat (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Drum Master Volume
parameters.description: Output volume of the drum machine.

parameters.name: Kick Out In Main Mix
parameters.description: Whether the kick also play in the main mix (outputs 1/2). In the JSFX they always play on their own outputs 3/4.

parameters.name: Snare/Clap Out In Main Mix
parameters.description: Whether the snare, clap and rimshot also play in the main mix (outputs 1/2). In the JSFX they always play on their own outputs 5/6.

parameters.name: Hats/Cymbals Out In Main Mix
parameters.description: Whether the hi-hats, crash and ride also play in the main mix (outputs 1/2). In the JSFX they always play on their own outputs 7/8.

parameters.name: Toms/Perc Out In Main Mix
parameters.description: Whether the toms, cowbell, shaker and the Latin / hand percussion also play in the main mix (outputs 1/2). In the JSFX they always play on their own outputs 9/10.

parameters.name: Tambourine Pitch
parameters.description: Base frequency of the jingle cluster (metallic squares).

parameters.name: Tambourine Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the jingles.

parameters.name: Tambourine Tone
parameters.description: High-pass cutoff (brightness).

parameters.name: Tambourine Level
parameters.description: Output level of the tambourine.

parameters.name: Tambourine Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the tambourine (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Conga Pitch

parameters.name: Conga Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the open hi conga.

parameters.name: Conga Tone

parameters.name: Conga Pan

parameters.name: Timbale Pitch

parameters.name: Timbale Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the timbale shell.

parameters.name: Timbale Tone
parameters.description: Stick attack: pitch bend plus stick noise.

parameters.name: Timbale Level
parameters.description: Output level of the timbale.

parameters.name: Timbale Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the timbale (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Agogo Pitch
parameters.description: High agogo bell (note 67); the low bell (68) is 0.75x.

parameters.name: Agogo Decay
parameters.description: Decay time of the bell.

parameters.name: Agogo Tone
parameters.description: Band-pass brightness.

parameters.name: Agogo Level
parameters.description: Output level of the agogo.

parameters.name: Agogo Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the agogo (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Claves Pitch
parameters.description: Claves (note 75); the hi / low wood blocks (76 / 77) are tuned from it.

parameters.name: Claves Decay
parameters.description: Ring time of the wood.

parameters.name: Claves Tone
parameters.description: Upper mode and click (hardness).

parameters.name: Claves Level
parameters.description: Output level of the claves.

parameters.name: Claves Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the claves (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Triangle Pitch
parameters.description: Lowest partial of the triangle.

parameters.name: Triangle Decay
parameters.description: Ring time of the open triangle (note 81); the mute triangle (80) is cut short and chokes it.

parameters.name: Triangle Tone
parameters.description: Balance of the upper partials (brightness).

parameters.name: Triangle Level
parameters.description: Output level of the triangle.

parameters.name: Triangle Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the triangle (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Vibraslap Pitch
parameters.description: Resonance of the rattle box.

parameters.name: Vibraslap Decay
parameters.description: How long the rattle goes on.

parameters.name: Vibraslap Tone
parameters.description: Rattle rate (slow .. fast clicks).

parameters.name: Vibraslap Level
parameters.description: Output level of the vibraslap.

parameters.name: Vibraslap Pan
parameters.description: Stereo position of the vibraslap (-1 = left, +1 = right).

parameters.name: Whistle Pitch
parameters.description: Pitch of the samba whistle.

parameters.name: Whistle Decay
parameters.description: Length of the long whistle (note 72); the short whistle (71) is 0.3x.

parameters.name: Whistle Tone
parameters.description: Trill of the pea inside (pitch and loudness warble).

parameters.name: Guiro Pitch
parameters.description: Resonance of the gourd (each ridge click rings at it).

parameters.name: Guiro Decay
parameters.description: Length of the long scrape (note 74); the short guiro (73) is 0.3x.

parameters.name: Guiro Tone
parameters.description: Ridge rate of the scrape (slow .. fast).

parameters.name: Guiro Level
parameters.description: Output level of the guiro.

parameters.name: Guiro Pan

presets.description: Punchy kick with a click, bright snappy snare, noisy hats.

presets.name: Tight Lo-fi
presets.description: Short, dry and dark: everything decays fast.

presets.name: Electro Big Room
presets.description: Huge distorted kick, wide clap, long cymbals.

presets.name: Dry House
presets.description: Compact four-on-the-floor kick, crisp snare/clap and short hats; leaves room for a bass line.

presets.name: Synthwave Arena
presets.description: Deep electronic kick, broad snare/clap and ringing toms for retro pop. Synthesized tails, no gated reverb.

presets.name: Soft Percussion
presets.description: Rounded kick, dry rim and subdued cymbals with forward shaker/toms; useful for sparse arrangements.

parameters.name: Slot
